claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Mike McCoole in a battle for the title with side bets, about 65 years before 1935.
claims.excerpt: In the ring, just before a battle for the title and side bets, with Tom Allen,

claims.statement: Before the fight, Mike McCoole bet Tom Allen $500 more that he would win, and lent Allen $200 to cover the bet because Allen had only $300.
claims.excerpt: Till lend you the other $200 to cover the bet

quotes.speaker: Mike McCoole
quotes.text: Till bet you $500 more I lick you.
